breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified both Dirichlet and Periodic boundary conditions. The ground truth removed the contradictory periodic condition. The generated specification correctly identified this conflict and only included the Dirichlet boundary conditions, stating 'Use Dirichlet boundary conditions u(0,t) = u(1,t) = 0 for all t', which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
